hypotheses.title: Candlestick Real Body Ratio Reversion 80D
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Candlestick real body ratio (abs(close - open) / (high - low + 0.0001 * close)) quantifies pure one-sided directional order-flow momentum versus wick rejection. With 80-day lookback and 0.1 offset, it captures faster inflection points in overextended institutional accumulation, pushing Sharpe from 1.17 to above 1.25.
confounders: Sustained secular breakout trends in high-growth equities
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during momentum-driven bull trends where large body candles continue advancing without mean-reverting.

candidates.expression: body = abs(close - open) / (high - low + 0.0001 * close); mean_body = group_mean(body, rank(ts_mean(cap, 60)), subindustry); disp = abs(body - mean_body) / (abs(body) + abs(mean_body) + 0.1); disp_smooth = ts_mean(disp, 80); body_std = ts_std_dev(body, 80); adj_body = disp_smooth * body_std * body; adj_mean = ts_mean(adj_body, 80); adj_std = ts_std_dev(adj_body, 80); bonus = zscore(adj_mean) + zscore(adj_std); signal = -quantile(bonus, driver="cauchy"); ts_decay_linear(signal, 80)

hypotheses.title: Candlestick Real Body Ratio Reversion 100D
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Real body ratio with an intermediate 100-day Cauchy dispersion window and 0.1 offset. Balances low turnover with heightened responsiveness to directional exhaustion across subindustry peers.
confounders: Regime changes with low intraday volatility
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during multi-quarter index momentum runs.

hypotheses.title: Candlestick Real Body Ratio Reversion 120D Offset Scaled
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Real body ratio over 120 days with a 0.1 stabilization offset in the dispersion denominator. Reduces noise in quiet stocks to elevate Sharpe past 1.25 while maintaining ~5% turnover and high Fitness.
confounders: Corporate takeovers with fixed offer prices
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails when stocks exhibit low daily price action due to illiquidity.
